stories.body: A new study of 67,248 areas converted from nonforest land into planted forests finds that fire outcomes vary substantially by ecological setting. Researchers used satellite records from 2001–2023 and accounted for climate, accessibility and…

featuredResource.title: 14-day VT Forestry Climate Adaptation Challenge
featuredResource.description: This free 14-day email course delivers daily units with podcast links about Vermont forestry climate adaptation. The sequence offers a structured way to work through the subject over two weeks.
